changes.reason: Keep nested outbox/inbox data independent across store and transaction boundaries, and reject values that cannot be snapshotted before writes.

kubernetes.reason: This change isolates values in the process-local test store. It introduces no deployed Host, durable storage, external Provider or lifecycle requirement and makes no runtime support claim.
constraints: The in-memory store remains non-durable test/local storage; no live infrastructure or provider certification is claimed.
